title: Instagram-style app UI
summary: Instagram effects as see-through overlays for talking-head footage, 1080x1920, kept in the top safe area above the face. Generic app look drawn in code; the handle, photo, covers and numbers are props.
usage: comment-dm: {"piece": "overlays/comment-dm", "theme": "ui/instagram", "start": 7.0, "end": 10.0, "props": {"keyword": "REEL", "handle": "yourhandle"}}. feed-scroll: "props": {"images": ["/projects/<name>/covers/01.jpg", …], "views": ["212K", …]}. insights-zoom: add a storyboard zoom over the same span, {"start": S + 0.45, "end": E - 0.4, "scale": 1.2}, for v1's camera push.

items.name: Comment keyword, get the DM
items.description: The CTA as Instagram: a comments sheet where a viewer types your keyword and taps Post, the comment lands, then your auto-DM arrives as a notification with your photo and handle. Props: keyword, handle (yourhandle), avatar (photo address; default the placeholder in this kit), viewer, message, other / otherText (an earlier comment), postAt, noteAt.

items.name: Feed scroll
items.description: A phone-style card above your head swipes up through your best reels like the feed, each cover with its view count and side dots. Props: images (cover addresses from the server root; default four of the user's reel covers), views (one label per cover; pass the real counts), count, size (0.36 of the frame width), x, y.

items.name: Reel insights
items.description: A reel-insights card slides in beside you: gradient header with a sparkline, icon rows counting up, a green growth pill and a highlighter under the top number, then the card pushes in on that row. Props: rows [{label, value}] (or "Label::value"), title, sub, growth, push (1.22), accent, accent2, highlight. Pair with a zoom for the camera push.

items.name: Send DMs
items.description: Outreach as the Instagram message thread: a white card under the speaker where your messages pop in one after another as outgoing blue bubbles, then Delivered under the last. Props: messages (up to 3 lines, illustrative copy), to (thread name), firstAt, step, x, y, width.
